messages:
Maya: Hey team — SureBridge asked for a customer-specific adaptive reranker for claims triage. They need PHI-safe outputs, 50ms p50, and per-customer fine-tuning behavior. Ticket: <https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-54321>

Jonah: digging in — do we have their dataset size and format? any sample PII/PHI examples?

Maya: they sent ~120k annotated pairs (CSV, columns: claim_text, label, customer_id). Some records contain PHI fields we need to redact before sharing with model infra.

Priya: re: PHI — mandatory: on-rest KMS, transit TLS, and model serving in their VPC or our Dedicated with private networking. Also need audit logs and redaction proofs.

Luis: sounds like 7B fine-tune or 13B distil? performance-wise 7B quantized gets closer to 50ms p50 on Dedicated with batching tuned. We can do prefix caching + KV optimization. Fallback plan -> route to generic reranker if latency spikes.

Jonah: metrics for eval: NDCG@10, MRR, latency p50/p95, and hallucination rate on a held-out PHI-sensitive test split. Also need fairness checks across customer segments.

Maya: FYI renewal is in 6 weeks, customer has hinted renewal depends on this feature. flagging as potential churn risk if timeline slips :exclamation:

Priya: action items from security: 1) confirm they will tokenise PHI upstream or provide a redacted dataset, 2) sign DPA addendum, 3) KMS key policy + HSM request if on-prem.

Luis: ops action items: 1) estimate infra cost for dedicated pool, 2) prepare canary rollout config (canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%), 3) add automatic fallback to base-reranker-v2. I'll drop draft infra estimate by EOD.

Maya: enablement: need a quick playbook for their support team — how to interpret reranker scores and troubleshoot misranks. Can someone own a 30m enablement session next week?

Jonah: I can run enablement Wed 10am PT. Also will produce eval harness; sample command:```bash
python eval/ranker_eval.py --predictions predictions.json --gold gold.json --metrics ndcg,mrr,latency
```

deploy-bot: Created rollout job #RJ-789 — status: queued. Assigned to Luis.

Maya: Proposed timeline: collect sanitized test set by Tue, run baseline eval Wed, start canary Thu, full rollout next Tue. Is that realistic?

Priya: security sign-off contingent on redaction proof and DPA. otherwise we can't host PHI in hosted mode — must be Dedicated or Private.

Luis: timeline OK if dataset arrives by Tue. I'll need 2 spare GPUs for canary for 48h.

Maya: I'll ping the customer for the sanitized dataset and DPA signature now. I'll update ticket CS-54321 with owners and timeline. Thanks all :thumbsup:
